# Little Red Studio Book Export QA

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: little-red-book-export-qa
Class: book_export_preflight_and_cover_geometry_qa
Canonical URL: https://base44.app/api/apps/698c1f429cfd9b61a605bfc7/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Authority: public discovery of bounded book-export QA with no publishing or distribution side effects
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- check if my book is ready for KDP
- validate my cover dimensions
- audit this paperback export
- is my book file ready to publish
- check page count and cover DPI

## Boundaries
- no approved external machine price or payment path is verified
- QA readiness does not authorize publishing, uploading or distributing a book
- page-count and cover-geometry checks are preflight signals rather than platform acceptance guarantees

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
